about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Saint Bartholomew the Apostle” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We have received, O Lord, the pledge of everlasting redemption; may it, by the intercession of blessed Bartholomew, Your Apostle, be our help both now and in the life to come. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
